name: code-block
title: Code block
description: Code to read and copy, in one dark window on the site and in the product: a pill for each request or language and Copy on one row, a rule, then the code. There is always at least one pill.
use_for: Requests, commands and configuration the person copies into their own tools.
never: Code shortened with a fade or a "show more": show what they copy in full
A window with no pill: name the code, such as cURL, CSS or JSON
body: A long line scrolls sideways under a fade (`fade-x`) at the edge with more past it.

examples.name: Product
examples.label: A pill per language
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import CodeBlock from '@/components/ui/CodeBlock.vue'
// The same window as on the site, a pill per language.
const samples = [
  { label: 'cURL', code: `curl https://api.conare.ai/v1/search \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CONARE_API_KEY" \\
  -d '{ "namespace": "contracts", "query": "notice period" }'` },
  { label: 'Python', code: `from conare import Conare

client = Conare()
hits = client.search(namespace="contracts", query="notice period")` },
  { label: 'TypeScript', code: `import Conare from "conare"

const client = new Conare()
const hits = await client.search({ namespace: "contracts", query: "notice period" })` },
]
</script>

<template>
  <CodeBlock :samples="samples" label="search request" />
</template>

    { label: 'TypeScript', code: `import Conare from "conare"

  ]
